meta.title: Wedding Invitations for Sri Lanka
meta.description: Create beautiful digital wedding invitations. Send personal links on WhatsApp. Track RSVPs — all from your phone.

hero.headline: Your wedding invitation, personal to every guest
hero.sub: Build a beautiful invitation site in minutes. Send each guest their own link on WhatsApp. See RSVPs as they arrive.

steps.label: How it works
steps.s1Desc: Choose from designs made for Sri Lankan weddings: Poruwa ceremonies, church weddings, receptions and homecomings.
steps.s2Desc: Fill in names, dates, venues and events. See changes live on a phone preview.
steps.s3Desc: Each guest gets a personal link. Tap to send with no app to install and no group to create.
steps.s4Desc: See who has opened, who has replied, and the head count for each event, updated live.

closing.headline: Ready to get started?
closing.sub: Free to build and preview. Pay once to publish.

footer.tagline: Digital wedding invitations for Sri Lanka
